intended_scope: Record the user's reported Salesforce migration confirmation and independently check the current workspace integration access and supported authenticated health capability.

reported_salesforce_status.source: User-provided update attributed to Salesforce confirmation
reported_salesforce_status.statement: Salesforce confirmed my org migration succeeded and the org is fully available. Integration health still needs checking at Salesforce confirmation.
reported_salesforce_status.interpretation: The successful migration and fully available organization are retained as reported facts. They are separate from current workspace connector access.

observed_workspace_integration.source: Fresh Plugin Management search for Salesforce Agentforce

integration_health.limitation: Administrator-disabled workspace access limits this integration check. It provides no evidence that the Salesforce organization itself is unavailable or that its reported migration failed.

closure_condition.owner: Existing Salesforce access owner and workspace administrator
closure_condition.needed: An approved supported authenticated Salesforce access path and a health/metadata read for the existing organization.
closure_condition.pass: A dated receiving-system response confirms the authenticated target org, current integration health and exact Agentforce identities/permissions. Preserve the reported successful migration separately from that response.

next_verifiable_step: Use the approved existing Salesforce connection to read authenticated integration health and target-org/Agentforce metadata; retain the response as a separately identified supplemental receipt.
